facts.text: White Barn Inn is located at 37 Beach Avenue in Kennebunk, Maine, near Kennebunkport and the Maine coast.
facts.excerpt: White Barn Inn is located at 37 Beach Avenue in Kennebunk, Maine, near Kennebunkport and the Maine coast.

facts.text: White Barn Inn has been a local landmark for over 150 years.
facts.excerpt: White Barn Inn has been a beloved local landmark for over 150 years

facts.text: The restaurant opened in the historic barn in 1973.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant opened in the historic barn in 1973

facts.text: The four houseboats, Cora, Nettie, Ivory and Grace, are each named for a member of the founding family of Cora Toothaker, who transformed the historic barn into an inn.
facts.excerpt: Each is named for a member of the founding family of Cora Toothaker, who transformed the historic barn into an inn nearly a century ago.

facts.text: Each houseboat has a private rooftop deck.
facts.excerpt: each houseboat features a generous private rooftop deck

facts.text: The houseboats are a 7 minute walk from the inn.
facts.excerpt: 7 minute walk from the inn

facts.text: The houseboats are not recommended for children ages 1 to 12.
facts.excerpt: We do not recommend the houseboats for children ages 1–12.

facts.text: The houseboats are seasonal.

facts.text: The cottages offer direct access to the heated Infinity pool or views of the Kennebunk River.
facts.excerpt: They combine space, privacy, and direct access to our heated Infinity pool or views of the Kennebunk River.

facts.text: Each suite has a gas-burning fireplace and a bathroom with a large jetted or soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Each one features a warming gas-burning fireplace and a luxurious bathroom with a large jetted or soaking tub.

facts.text: Private dining can be set up in the wine cellar, which holds 7,000 wine bottles.
facts.excerpt: our dining team can set up an intimate private dining experience in our spectacular wine cellar surrounded by 7,000 wine bottles.

facts.text: Little Barn is a relaxed, casual restaurant that serves dishes from local Maine farms and fisheries.
facts.excerpt: the flavorful and approachable dishes at the Little Barn bring the local Maine farmstead and fisheries to the table.

facts.text: The spa offers massages, body treatments, facials, a couples spa suite and a sensory rain shower.
facts.excerpt: White Barn Inn has a full-service spa offering massages, body treatments, facials, a couples spa suite and a sensory rain shower.

facts.text: The outdoor pool is seasonal, with full amenities during the summer months.
facts.excerpt: White Barn Inn has a seasonal outdoor pool with full amenities during the summer months.

facts.text: The hotel can help arrange car service from Portland International Jetport but does not provide airport pickups or shuttle service.
